So yesterday my coworkers and I were discussing good BLT's and I started coming up with an idea of the ultimate BLT. Part of my idea I actually made today and it was indulgent to say the least!

Step 1. Make Baconaise. (Mayo made with 1/2 bacon fat and 1/2 oil) I made mine with:

1/2 cup Olive Oil

1/2 cup melted Bacon Fat

2 eggs

1 tbs lemon juice

1 teaspoon kosher salt

A nice pinch of cayenne

1 small garlic glove - mashed

1 tbs Dijon mustard

2 slices of bacon minced

Step 2. Use the Baconnaise instead of butter to grill the bread in a pan. (I learned about using mayo instead of butter when I worked at 5 guys a long time ago - it's what they do to all their buns)

Step 3. Use the baconaise inside the sandwich as well.

That's as far as I got, which was super tasty, and didn't get too complicated so as to destroy the simplicity that is a BLT. I did also get to use a tomato fresh from my garden which was pretty delicious as well, lettuce was just iceberg because it was all I had on hand.
